description:
A shareable, named search pipeline: how a hybrid query's per-clause scores are normalized and combined. NamedSearchPipelines belong to an Organization and are identified by the qualified name {organizationName}-{name}.

Example:

{
  "organizationName": "biomed",
  "name": "keyword_heavy",
  "settings": {
    "phase_results_processors": [
      {
        "normalization-processor": {
          "normalization": { "technique": "min_max" },
          "combination": {
            "technique": "arithmetic_mean",
            "parameters": { "weights": [0.4, 0.3, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1] }
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}

id.description: The unique ID of this search pipeline.

organizationName.description: The name of the Organization this resource belongs to. Immutable after creation.

name.description: The resource name. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, and underscores. Unique within the organization and immutable after creation. Used as part of the qualified name ({organizationName}-{name}) when referenced by other resources.

description.description: Optional description of the search pipeline.

settings.description: Required. The search pipeline this resource holds. On save: phase_results_processors must hold exactly one entry that sets normalization-processor; combination.parameters.weights, when set, must hold exactly 5 entries, each in [0.0, 1.0], with a sum greater than 0; and the z_score normalization technique is only allowed with the arithmetic_mean combination technique.

etag.description: Synapse employs an Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) scheme.

createdOn.description: The date this resource was created.

createdBy.description: The ID of the user that created this resource.

modifiedOn.description: The date this resource was last modified.

modifiedBy.description: The ID of the user that last modified this resource.
